Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To finish our vendor setup for Helix Consortium we need two quick items before we can release the first payment:

1) A confirmation of Redwood's payee classification for US tax purposes (do you require a W-9 or can you accept a W-8BEN-E? Redwood is a US entity).
2) Invoice format for EU customers — our AP team requires either VAT charges shown or a clear reverse-charge statement when applicable. Can you confirm the exact invoice wording Redwood needs if we apply reverse charge (we are in DE, VAT ID: DE123456789)?

We can attach our W-8BEN-E if needed and a VAT certificate. Also: our payments team prefers EUR wires; please confirm the bank details + required payee name on the Redwood invoice to avoid delays.

Attached: initial vendor info template (we can send signed documents as PDFs).

Best,
Sophie Martin\Head of Procurement\Helix Consortium

Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding / tax residency + invoice VAT question

Hi Sophie — thanks, and great to meet you on the call. Quick answers below so your AP team can move forward. Looping in Aditya (finance) and Marissa (payments) to confirm bank/invoice formatting.

1) Tax form: Because Redwood is a US C-corp, we generally provide a W-9 for US-sourced payments. If Helix is a foreign entity and payments originate from EU subsidiaries, a W-8BEN-E can also be accepted to certify foreign status for US withholding purposes. Please send the completed form you prefer and we will route it to AP.

2) EU VAT / reverse charge: For DE customers using the reverse-charge mechanism, the invoice should include:
   - Our description lines (service description, quantity, unit price, net amount)
   - A separate line showing NET total (no VAT applied)
   - The following statement exactly: "Reverse charge — VAT liability transferred to the customer under Article 194(1) EU VAT Directive."
   - Helix's VAT ID: DE123456789, and Redwood's VAT ID placeholder (we will provide ours once Marissa confirms).

3) Bank details & payee name: Marissa / Aditya — can you confirm: preferred payee name for wire, full IBAN/BIC for EUR rails, and whether we require any intermediate bank instructions for Helix?

If easier, Sophie, you can upload signed copies of W-8BEN-E / VAT certificate to the Drive link and we will pull them into the vendor record.

Thanks,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Partnerships\Redwood Inference
[Jonas Weber | +1 415-555-0192]

Hi Sophie — thank you for sending the docs. We received the W-8BEN-E and VAT cert. A few follow-ups from finance to avoid payment delay:

1) Beneficial owner attestation: the bank requires a signed statement that lists UBOs with >25% ownership and a government ID for each UBO. The declaration you attached looks good but can you confirm it lists names and percentages? If not, please attach the short UBO table.

2) W-8BEN-E: we need the company EIN (if applicable) or the US tax form box numbers completed for chapter 3/chapter 4 status. If Helix is claiming treaty benefits, please indicate box 14.

3) Invoice sample: to standardize we asked Marissa to create a template with the exact wording to include on Helix invoices. Marissa, can you confirm the payee name (legal entity) Redwood wants on the invoice and provide the IBAN/BIC? Also confirm NET30 is acceptable.

Once we have the UBO table and the W-8 details above, we will push the vendor through onboarding and release the first EUR wire within our next cycle.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations
